children.title: What is the minimum investment to start a Patnam Pakodi franchise?
children.text: Our smallest Display Model starts at ₹69,000. Cart, Cabin (4×6) and Premium Shop setups are available at ₹1,10,000, ₹1,59,000 and ₹2,50,000 respectively.

children.title: Do I need cooking experience or a chef?
children.text: No. Our proprietary chef-less SOP model uses standardized marination and controlled frying so any trained operator can deliver the same signature taste.

children.title: How does area protection work?
children.text: Each franchise partner gets an exclusive 2 KM protected area so no other Patnam Pakodi outlet operates in your zone.

children.title: What kind of support do I get during launch?
children.text: Complete outlet setup, kitchen kit, staff training on our SOP, branding, packaging, menu boards and grand-launch marketing support.

children.title: How many menu variants can I offer?
children.text: Our standardized system supports 50+ menu variations including wings, strips, lollipops, popcorn chicken and signature pakodi variants.
Become our franchise partner today. Start your highly lucrative Patnam Pakodi franchise journey.

children.text: Patnam Pakodi is one of India’s fastest-growing chicken pakodi franchise brands, serving crispy, flavorful, and hygienically prepared chicken snacks using our unique chef-less SOP system. Our mission is to make premium chicken pakodi accessible everywhere through profitable and easy-to-operate franchise outlets.

Patnam Pakodi started with one simple vision — to bring authentic Guntur-style chicken pakodi to every food lover while creating profitable business opportunities for entrepreneurs. Traditional recipes, standardized preparation methods, and premium ingredients helped us create a franchise model that anyone can operate successfully without requiring professional chefs. Today, Patnam Pakodi continues to expand with a strong focus on taste, quality, consistency, and customer satisfaction.
To become India’s most trusted chicken pakodi franchise brand by delivering authentic taste, operational excellence, and profitable business opportunities across every city.
To empower entrepreneurs through a chef-less franchise model that guarantees quality, consistency, affordability, and customer satisfaction.
Become a Part of India's Fast-Growing Chicken Pakodi Franchise
Start your successful food business journey with Patnam Pakodi today.

children.title: Which cities currently have branches?
children.text: We are actively serving across Hyderabad — Kukatpally, Madhapur, Miyapur, Gachibowli, Dilsukhnagar, LB Nagar and more — with new outlets opening in Vijayawada, Bangalore and Chennai soon.

children.title: How can I locate my nearest branch?
children.text: Use the search bar above or scroll to the map section. Enter your city or area and we’ll show you the closest Patnam Pakodi outlet with live directions.

children.title: Do all branches have the same menu?
children.text: Yes. Every branch follows the same standardized menu and SOP — so the Guntur Pachi Mirchi Pakodi you love in Kukatpally tastes identical in LB Nagar.

children.title: Can I order online?
children.text: Absolutely. All branches are live on Swiggy and Zomato, and you can also call the branch directly for pickup orders.

children.title: How do I apply for a franchise?
